terms.comment: Our description, for a slender rod such as the metal rod that curtain rings run on. The nouns are classical. Traupman and Morgan–Owens have words for the curtain (aulaeum, vēlum, Traupman 123, 300; cortīna, M-O s.v. curtain) but none for the rod, the pole or the track. A thicker pole is pertica aulaeī.

phrases.english: The curtain hangs from the rod.

sources: Lewis & Short: virga · Lewis & Short: pertica · Morgan–Owens: rod
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 123, 300.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. curtain.
